method.dashboard_cold_start: one Streamlit AppTest render after clearing Streamlit resource cache; excludes OS/process startup and is not deployment latency
method.service_and_artifact_load: one new TrafficService followed by first load of all four saved model artifacts
method.selected_forecast: one first prediction, then ten repeated warm predictions for the service default held-out window and sensor 773869-equivalent first sensor
method.evaluation: first full test evaluation, then one cached evaluation call
method.memory: resource.getrusage maximum resident set size after each stage, normalized to bytes; process-wide high-water mark

memory_bytes.note: RSS includes interpreter and libraries; this is a process-wide high-water mark, not attributable incremental memory.
